messages:
sophie_sales: Quick ask - Cumulus Health is requesting an onboarding concession. They expanded to Dedicated earlier than planned and want a 15% credit for first 3 months (~$30k) plus Net60 while procurement finishes approvals. Can finance approve?
eli_finance: Need concrete numbers and whether this is a billing error or promotional concession. 15% of what exact invoice?
sophie_sales: Their run-rate for the Dedicated pool is ~$200k/quarter. They want 15% off the next three invoices (~$30k total) OR a one-time $25k credit. Also Net60 for 2 invoices. It's a strategic healthcare pilot.
nora_revops: Flag: credits >$10k require comp ops sign-off and will affect MRR recognition; also watch for precedent on promotional credits for healthcare partners.
dara_legal: We can offer a one-time promotional credit but must get a signed amendment/acknowledgement. Also recommend limiting payment-term change to Net45, not Net60, unless AR signs off.
simon_ar: Net60 will materially increase DSO; AR needs to approve on a case-by-case basis. With current collections, Net60 is tough. Net45 for up to two cycles is manageable.
eli_finance: Finance policy: directors can approve up to $15k. Anything beyond needs VP/CFO. Given risk, propose compromise: $15k credit + Net45 for next two invoices, contingent on signed acknowledgment stating non-recurring concession.
sophie_sales: If we can't reach $25k, $15k + Net45 x2 is acceptable to the customer to keep the deal. They prefer quick resolution.
nora_revops: I'll open comp ops ticket CO-3952 to log commission impacts for a $15k credit. Sales to confirm if AE is taking any override.
dara_legal: Draft acknowledgement: "Redwood Inference will apply a one-time credit of $15,000 to invoice(s) specified; this credit is non-recurring and does not modify the master subscription agreement. Payment terms for the next two invoices will be Net45. Customer must sign and return to trigger credit application." I'll paste wording for Sophie to send.
billing-bot: Customer account retrieved: CUMULUS-HTH-01. Latest invoice INV-2026-0881 shows Dedicated charges: 
```
Dedicated Pool: 16 GPUs x 720h = $96,000
Support & Onboarding: $8,000
Tax: $3,200
Total: $107,200
```
eli_finance: Approving internally: $15,000 credit + Net45 x2 invoices. Please attach signed customer ack to Deal Desk entry DDK-2026-130. Any request to increase to $25k must escalate to VP Finance.
sophie_sales: Sending to Cumulus now with legal text. Will push for signed ack within 48h.
nora_revops: Comp ops CO-3952 created and linked to DDK-2026-130.
billing-bot: Action queued: create CM-2026-080 for $15,000 pending receipt of customer_ack_cumulus_2026-03-10.eml. Will apply CM after ack.
simon_ar: AR notified. Once credit applied, update aging and cash forecast.
dara_legal: Please ensure the signed ack contains the sentence: "This acknowledgement and credit resolve the dispute in full and are non-precedential."
sophie_sales: Cumulus signed and returned the ack: "Ack and agreed." Uploading to Deal Desk.
illing-bot: (typo) -- ignore
billing-bot: CM-2026-080 created and scheduled for apply on 2026-03-11 after receipt of customer ack.
eli_finance: Final: approve $15k credit + Net45 x2. Documented in DDK-2026-130 and CO-3952. Closing thread once CM applied.
sophie_sales: Thanks all, saved the renewal. :tada:
